description: Navigate to the 'Science' category in GCompris and open the 'Gravity' activity (icon showing a planet/projectile). Your goal is to hit the target object with the projectile. 1. Launch the activity. 2. Fire the projectile to test the current settings. 3. Adjust the 'Angle' and 'Velocity' (Speed) sliders based on where the projectile lands. 4. Fire again. Repeat until the projectile hits the target and the success animation/message appears. Take a screenshot of the success state.
